verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a self-hosted setup that runs all of Sentry on your own server for free. Hands-on reports confirm it can run as a working instance that is rock-solid once up, and it includes Dashboards for testing instrumentation. Real caveats remain: the self-hosted setup is minimal with no guarantees or support, users report a heavy and growing container and memory footprint (one team's 32GB server could run only Sentry), and self-hosted releases lag behind SaaS. missing for 10: lightweight local/dev-mode guidance, evidence of a small-footprint local spin-up, and feature parity with SaaS (including dashboards) in self-hosted.
